BiblicalUsage: Paul tells the church to withdraw from every brother who walks disorderly, and he had heard that some were walking disorderly, working not at all but acting as busybodies. The word is the adverb form, describing the walk itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a disordered walk harms the whole church, because idleness and meddling travel together.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
